task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First of all, you could, like, doublecheck that the chest drawer within the bedroom is ajar. After that, take the old key from the chest drawer inside the bedroom. With the old key, unlock the wooden door in the bedroom. After that, make sure that the wooden door is ajar. Then, make an attempt to take a trip east. If you can get through with that, ensure that the screen door is open. Once you have opened the screen door, go east. With that over with, move south. Next, retrieve the half of a bag of chips from the floor of the garden. After getting the half of a bag of chips, attempt to go north. Then, attempt to venture west. If you can manage that, rest the half of a bag of chips on the stove in the kitchen. And once you've done that, you win!

feedback:
You have moved into the most standard of all possible kitchens. You can barely contain your excitement.

You see a refrigerator. You shudder, but continue examining the room. Oh, great. Here's a counter. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about a counter? But there isn't a thing on it. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it? You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a stove. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Silly stove, silly, empty, good for nothing stove. You can see a kitchen island. You shudder, but continue examining the kitchen island. The kitchen island is normal. On the kitchen island you can make out a note. You idly wonder how they came up with the name TextWorld for this place. It's pretty fitting.

There is a closed screen door leading east. There is an open wooden door leading west. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unblocked. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unblocked.
